query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('session_id',s.id,'workspace_id',s.workspace_id,'conversation_id',s.conversation_id,'file_ids',ARRAY(SELECT u.file_id FROM assistant_uploads u WHERE u.workspace_id=s.workspace_id AND u.session_id=s.id AND u.file_id IS NOT NULL AND u.state<>'cleaned')) AS "data!" FROM assistant_sessions s WHERE s.state<>'cleaned' AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM assistant_uploads u WHERE u.workspace_id=s.workspace_id AND u.session_id=s.id AND u.state='reserved' AND u.created_at>now()-interval '60 seconds') AND (s.state='closed' OR s.expires_at<=now() OR s.last_seen_at<=now()-interval '15 minutes' OR NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM access_tokens t WHERE t.id=s.login_id AND t.expires_at>now())) ORDER BY s.last_seen_at LIMIT 100
